The '''mother''' of [[Raina Temple]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as a [[Cipher Agent]] for [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She married fellow agent [[Cipher Three]].
